name: Epilepsy
overview: Scripture reveals that Jesus demonstrated His divine authority and compassion by healing those afflicted with various illnesses and spiritual oppression, including those described as lunatick or possessed with dumb spirits, conditions historically associated with epilepsy. The Gospel accounts, such as the healing of a boy who frequently fell into fire and water, emphasize Christ's power over both physical ailments and demonic influences, underscoring His role as the compassionate Healer who restores body and soul.
